test_description: Packet burst — test 4x64 sequential burst cadence, 5th unconsumed burst backpressure (overflow_drops==64), and oversized burst (n_pkts=100 > 64) handling
input_contract: 4 slots x 64 packets sustained with 0 drops when consumed; full ring returns false & records drops; n_pkts > 64 must not silently drop packets
independent_oracle: Slot FSM state transitions (FREE->DMA_OWNED->CPU_READY->CPU_OWNED->FREE) + packet conservation count

expected.4_slot_cadence_and_5th_backpressure: 256 consumed with 0 drops; 5th unconsumed returns false with overflow_drops=64
expected.oversized_burst_100_pkts: Reject or record 36 excess packets in overflow_drops
